candidate.description: PROC-301 Management Page Parser documentation (PROCESS.md + heir.yaml) evaluated against the Unified Template (6th locked constant, 14 sections / 3 clusters) and Grid Reader Pattern (Updater role requirements)
candidate.scope: Documentation structure validation only — not code correctness. Boundary: PROCESS.md, heir.yaml, CLAUDE.md measured against law/UNIFIED_TEMPLATE.md and law/doctrine/GRID_READER_PATTERN.md. US handoff: 10 invariant layers, 24 sub-layers, domestication depth 3.

elements.description: Three cluster headers required by Unified Template: IDENTITY (Thing), CONTRACT (Flow), GOVERNANCE (Change). Subject has zero — all 14 sections are flat-listed with no cluster grouping.
elements.format: 3 H1 headers with primitive annotation (Thing/Flow/Change), each grouping the sections beneath

elements.description: Section 1 Identity table. Subject has 11 fields (Process ID, Name, Business Silo, CTB Position, ORBT, Strikes, Last Deployed, BAR Reference, Deployed URL, Cron, Runtime). Template requires 10 fields (ID, Name, Medium, Business Silo, CTB Position, ORBT, Strikes, Authority, Last Modified, BAR Reference). Subject is missing Medium, Authority, Last Modified. Has 4 non-standard fields (Last Deployed, Deployed URL, Cron, Runtime).
elements.format: Table with 10 named fields per Unified Template Section 1

elements.description: HEIR 8-field schema in heir.yaml. Present fields: sovereign_ref, hub_id, cc_layer, ctb_placement (4 of 8). Missing fields: imo_topology, services, secrets_provider, acceptance_criteria. Non-standard fields present: heir_ref, sub_hub, component, created_at.
elements.format: 8 named fields per law/heir_schema.yaml: sovereign_ref, hub_id, ctb_placement, imo_topology, cc_layer, services, secrets_provider, acceptance_criteria

elements.description: Template Section 2 PURPOSE. Subject has it as Section 2 'WHY THIS EXISTS'. Content satisfies the structural constraint (names what breaks, names downstream dependency). Name deviates from template.
elements.format: Prose block: 2-3 sentences naming what breaks and what downstream starves

elements.description: Template Section 3 RESOURCES (unified: Dependencies + Downstream Consumers + Tools + Secrets). Subject splits this across Section 4 'WHAT IT GRABS OFF THE WALL' (Databases, Tools, Secrets) and Section 8 'DEPENDENCIES' (Upstream/Downstream). All 4 sub-tables exist in the subject but are not unified under one section.
elements.format: One section with 4 sub-tables: Dependencies (4 cols), Downstream Consumers (2 cols), Tools & Integrations (5 cols), Secrets (4 cols)

elements.description: Template Section 4 IMO. Subject has it as Section 3. All 5 sub-components present: Two-Question Intake (both answered), Input block, Middle table (7 rows x 6 cols — template requires 5 cols, subject adds 'Name'), Output block, Circle block. Structurally complete. Position deviates (section 3 vs template section 4).
elements.format: 5 sub-components: Two-Question Intake, Input, Middle table (5 cols), Output, Circle

elements.description: Template Section 5 DATA SCHEMA. Subject has it as Section 5 'OSAM'. READ table present (1 row). WRITE table present (2 rows). Forbidden Paths present (5 rows). MISSING: Join Chain sub-section (tree notation from spine ID). Invariant layer L9 requires all 4 sub-sections.
elements.format: 4 sub-sections: READ table (3 cols), WRITE table (3 cols), Join Chain (tree notation), Forbidden Paths (2 cols)

elements.description: Template Section 6 DMJ (Define, Map, Join). ENTIRELY ABSENT from subject. The orchestrator pre-observations flagged this. Subject embeds Key Builder concepts in the IMO Middle steps but lacks the explicit three-table DMJ structure (Define table L19, Map table L20, Join table L21). This is the highest-severity structural gap.
elements.format: 3 ordered sub-sections: 6a Define table (5 cols), 6b Map table (3 cols), 6c Join table (3 cols)

elements.description: Template Section 7 C&V. Subject has it as Section 6. Contains mathematical definitions (P(x;theta), r(x), stability), Constants table (7 items with comparators), Variables list. Structurally complete. Position deviates (section 6 vs template section 7).
elements.format: Two sub-sections: Constants list, Variables list. Per Bedrock section 2.

elements.description: Template Section 8 STOP CONDITIONS with 6 canonical conditions from Bedrock. Subject has it as Section 7 with 5 conditions. Missing canonical conditions: (1) can't answer two-question intake, (2) data schema question can't be routed, (3) budget cap reached. Has domain-specific: 'all about_url companies have has_name = 1' which is valid but supplements, not replaces.
elements.format: Table: 2 cols (Condition, Action). Minimum 6 canonical rows from Bedrock section 6/8.

elements.description: Template Section 9 VERIFICATION. Subject has it as Section 9 'SMOKE TEST'. Contains 4 numbered executable steps + Three Primitives Check with all 3 questions. Structurally complete. Name deviates from template.
elements.format: 2 sub-sections: numbered steps (action -> expected result), Three Primitives Check (3 binary questions)

elements.description: Template Section 10 ANALYTICS with 3 sub-sections: 10a Metrics, 10b Sigma Tracking, 10c ORBT Gate Rules. Subject has it as Section 10 with all 3 sub-sections present. Metrics table has 7 comparators. Sigma tracking has 3 metrics. ORBT has 4 transitions. Structurally complete.
elements.format: 3 sub-sections: Metrics (5 cols), Sigma Tracking (6 cols), ORBT Gate Rules (3 cols with 4 transitions)

elements.description: Template Section 11 EXECUTION TRACE. Subject has it as Section 11. References 14-field schema and append-only constraint. No entries yet (BUILD state). Structurally adequate but does not enumerate all 14 field definitions inline — references them.
elements.format: Schema table: 14 fields (trace_id through signed_by) with format and required columns

elements.description: Template Section 12 LOGBOOK. Subject has it as Section 12. States 'Created ONLY when the auditor certifies BUILD -> OPERATE.' Correctly deferred. Structurally compliant.
elements.format: Birth Certificate table: 7 fields. Created only after BUILD->OPERATE certification.

elements.description: Template Section 13 FLEET FAILURE REGISTRY. Subject has it as Section 13. Table with 7 columns matching template. Empty (no failures yet). Structurally compliant.
elements.format: Table: 7 cols (Pattern ID, Location, Error Code, First Seen, Occurrences, Strike Count, Status)

elements.description: Template Section 14 SESSION LOG. Subject has it as Section 14. Table with 3 columns matching template. 6 entries. Structurally compliant.
elements.format: Table: 3 cols (Date, What Was Done, LBB Record)

elements.description: Grid Reader Pattern requires two timestamps per tracked field for Updater processes: last_checked (when YOU looked) and last_changed (when THEY changed). Subject's WRITE table documents person_found_at and linkedin_found_at but NOT the canonical Grid Reader timestamp pair. This is required for PROC-301's role as an Updater in the People sub-hub.
elements.format: Per tracked field: last_checked (datetime), last_changed (datetime)

elements.description: Template assigns sections to specific numbers within clusters (1-3 in IDENTITY, 4-8 in CONTRACT, 9-14 in GOVERNANCE). Subject uses 1-14 flat numbering with sections in different positions (e.g., IMO is section 3 instead of 4, Resources split as 4 and 8 instead of unified 3).
elements.format: 14 sections numbered sequentially within 3 cluster groups

elements.description: Subject declares Template Version 4.0.0. The standard is the file at law/UNIFIED_TEMPLATE.md (the 6th locked constant). Template file does not carry a version number — it IS the standard. Document Control block is missing Medium and US Validated fields that the template includes.
elements.format: Table: Created, Last Modified, Version, Template Version, Medium, US Validated, Governing Engine

elements.description: Grid Reader Pattern states 'the grid is a view, not a table' and 'sub-hubs write, the grid reads.' PROC-301 writes directly to slot_workbench (the grid-level table) rather than writing to a sub-hub table (e.g., page_contacts) that the grid reads. The IMO Middle Step 5 (ORGANIZER) mentions a page_contacts table but the WRITE section only lists slot_workbench.
elements.format: CQRS: process writes to sub-hub table, grid view reads from sub-hub tables

cluster_header_gap.measurement: Count of 3 required cluster headers (IDENTITY/Thing, CONTRACT/Flow, GOVERNANCE/Change) absent from the subject document. Source: L2, L3, L4 invariant layers.

missing_section_count.measurement: Count of 14 template-required sections that are entirely absent from the subject. A section present under a different name counts as present (name deviation tracked separately). DMJ (Section 6) is the only fully absent section.

section_name_deviation_count.measurement: Count of sections present in subject but named differently than the Unified Template standard. WHY THIS EXISTS (vs PURPOSE), WHAT IT GRABS OFF THE WALL (vs RESOURCES), OSAM (vs DATA SCHEMA), SMOKE TEST (vs VERIFICATION) = 4 deviations. DEPENDENCIES counted under structural split, not name.

section_position_deviation_count.measurement: Count of sections whose position (section number) in the subject differs from the Unified Template assignment. Without cluster headers, all sections in CONTRACT and GOVERNANCE clusters are displaced. Counting sections individually: IMO (3 vs 4), Resources (4+8 vs 3), Data Schema (5 vs 5 OK), C&V (6 vs 7), Stop Conditions (7 vs 8), Dependencies (8 vs part of 3), Verification (9 vs 9 OK). = 5 displaced.

heir_field_gap.measurement: Count of 8 required HEIR fields (per law/heir_schema.yaml) that are missing from heir.yaml. Missing: imo_topology, services, secrets_provider, acceptance_criteria = 4 fields absent.

identity_table_field_gap.measurement: Count of 10 required Identity table fields (per Unified Template Section 1) missing from subject. Missing: Medium, Authority, Last Modified = 3 fields absent.

data_schema_subsection_gap.measurement: Count of 4 required Data Schema sub-sections (READ, WRITE, Join Chain, Forbidden Paths) missing from subject. Missing: Join Chain = 1 sub-section absent.

canonical_stop_condition_gap.measurement: Count of 6 canonical stop conditions (Bedrock section 6/8) missing from subject. Missing: (1) can't answer two-question intake, (2) data schema question can't be routed, (3) budget cap reached = 3 absent.

grid_reader_timestamp_gap.measurement: Count of required Grid Reader timestamp pairs (last_checked, last_changed) not documented in subject's WRITE section for tracked fields. Subject documents person_found_at and linkedin_found_at but not the canonical pair. Gap = 2 (one pair missing for person fields, one for linkedin fields).

resource_structural_split_count.measurement: Count of template sections that are split across multiple subject sections instead of unified. Template Section 3 RESOURCES is split across subject Section 4 (WHAT IT GRABS OFF THE WALL) and Section 8 (DEPENDENCIES) = 1 structural split.

execution_trace_field_gap.measurement: Count of 14 required execution trace fields not enumerated inline in the subject's Execution Trace section. Subject references the schema but does not list all 14 fields with format and required columns as the template does. Gap = 14 (none enumerated inline).

document_control_field_gap.measurement: Count of template Document Control fields missing from subject. Template requires: Created, Last Modified, Version, Template Version, Medium, US Validated, Governing Engine. Subject missing: Medium, US Validated = 2 fields absent.
